verdict.rationale: Canny's docs say Autopilot automatically captures feedback from support, sales, and review platforms. Named sources span the story's three categories: Intercom (support), Gong, Fathom and Fireflies (sales calls), and Slack (chat), plus "dozens of other sources." Missing for 10: detailed per-integration docs for the support and chat connectors (Intercom and Slack get only one-line mentions), and independent or hands-on confirmation that capture works as claimed.
